newsletters.title: July Newsletter Campaigns - Existing Customer Base
newsletters.note: 4 sends across 2 customer lists in July. Lists were originally separate but have been combined into one for August. Newsletter domain is connected to Google Postmaster.

campaigns.name: July Sale - List 2
campaigns.failNote: SendGrid limit hit (HTTP 403). Resolved before re-dos.

insights: Newsletters crushed it: 20.8% open rate across 8,641 sends - nearly 3x the sequence average (7.85%). Warm audience, strong subject lines.
List 2 had 450 SendGrid failures on the first send (HTTP 403 messaging limit). Fixed before re-do campaigns, which had zero failures.
Combined lists for August: 4,684 clean contacts. One unified newsletter send will be more efficient.
Combined total: 22,801 sends (8,641 newsletter + 14,160 sequences). Newsletter is 38% of sends but drives 62% of opens - significantly more efficient.
Volume doubled: 14,160 sequence sends vs 7,138 prior (+98%) with excellent list quality.
Bounce rate collapsed: 5.56% to 2.82% - only 3 new bounces on 7,022 additional sends.
Newsletters are the traffic engine: 2,776 GA events (62.7%) from newsletter campaigns.
MailChimp sequence is the hidden gem: 9.96% OR, 1.01% CTR, 4 replies, near-zero bounce rate.
Newsletters outperform sequences 3:1 on open rate: 20.8% vs 7.85%. Newsletter drove 62% of all opens from just 38% of total sends. Warm audience + SendGrid delivery is a winning formula.
Existing Customers open rate improved: 5.66% to 6.88% (+1.22pp) - SMS+email combo working.
Deliverability is rock-solid: 0% spam rate, 100% authentication, near-zero delivery errors.
4th of July underperforming: 2.80% OR on 3,464 members. Replaced by Bonus Days August.
Unsubscribe rate is healthy: 70 unsubscribes = 0.49% - well under 1% threshold.
Replies doubled with strong sentiment: 5 to 11 replies. 7 of 9 human replies positive/interested.
GA traffic exploded +169%: 1,645 to 4,426 events.
List hygiene completed: 4,799 to 4,684 verified contacts after removing duplicates and bounces.
nextSteps: Launch Bonus Days August 2026 campaigns on August 1. Creative ready, intent list built fresh.
Replace 4th of July with Bonus Days August. Fresh curated intent data.
Revive Anonymous Visitors in August - test Agent Loop and enable email validation.
Send unified August newsletter to combined 4,684-contact list - one send instead of two. Verify SendGrid limits are increased before August send.
Run customer database audit at end of August. Last audit July 30.
Verify getporchandpatiostore.com in Google Postmaster for more accurate reputation data.
